w: At 10.30 am Swamishri addressed a Medico-Spiritual Conference, "The root cause of all diseases are the evil elements within. To redeem oneself of them we have the holy shastras and sadhus. Just as there is a manual for a machine, likewise, this God given body is like a machine, the shastras are the manuals and sadhus are the doctors ..."
28 & 29 August 2000: (V.S. 2056, Shravan Vad 12 & 13) Sunday & Monday, New York: World Millennium Peace Summit, United Nations
Prayers by BAPS sadhus.

ph: An educating Medico-Spiritual Conference was organized in New York on August 27, 2000. Over 100 doctors were enlightened by Swamishri and saints to include spiritual dimension in modern medicine

w: Day 1 - National Bal-Balika Shibir 2004 Parallel to the National Family Shibir, the Bal-Balika Shibir - 'Atmabuddhi' commenced at Shri Swaminarayan Mandir, Neasden, London. Over 500 balaks and balikas gathered from all over the UK and Europe. Through various inspiring presentations by sadhus and co-ordinators, the children gained a clearer understanding of the importance of imbibing spiritual and moral values from a young age. Swamishri attended the shibir during the evening and treated the children to an inspiring game in which they understood Swamishri's wish of cultivating satsang in life and excelling in studies.

Day 1 - National Family Shibir 2004 The National Family Shibir - 'Karishye Vachanam Tava' commenced on 27 August at Shri Swaminarayan Mandir, Neasden, London. Over 1200 yuvak and yuvati participants from all over the UK and Europe attended. Senior sadhus explained Swamishri's message of observing niyams, ghar sabha, puja with tilak-chandlo and spiritual discourses, through inspiring speeches. In his blessings at the end of the day, Swamishri talked on the importance of keeping faith in the words of God and His holy Sadhu.

Swamishri arrived in the Janmashtmi celebration assembly at 9.00 pm. During the assembly, Swamishri inaugurated a new audio cassette publication by Swaminarayan Aksharpith entitled Rath Par Baithe Bihari. It features bhajans describing festivals held in the presence of Shriji Maharaj.

Blessing the celebration assembly, Swamishri said, “God incarnates on earth to liberate countless souls. But those who are evil-minded do not like it when God manifests85. The Gita describes the battle between good and evil. In the end, good triumphs. Peace and happiness lies in that. By narrating and listening to the divine episodes of God, peace is experienced. If one listens to evil, then misery is experienced.” At 11.00 pm Swamishri performed the celebration assembly to mark the birth of Bhagwan Shri Krishna. After the arti, celebratory bhajans were sung before the assembly ended.

st.t: BAPS Swaminarayan Mandir, Chicago, IL Celebrates First Patotsav, Saturday, August 27, 2005
w: Exactly one year after His Holiness Pramukh Swami Maharaj performed the inauguration ceremony of the BAPS Shree Swaminarayan Mandir in Chicago, IL, devotees gathered on Aug. 20 to celebrate the first Patotsav of the majestic mandir, Janmashtami and to dedicate the main gate symbolizing entry into ultimate peace.

The historic festivities began with sadhus performing the abhishek of the murtis in all three shrines, with panchamrut (a mixture of water, milk, yoghurt, honey, sugar and ghee) and with devotees having the opportunity to perform the sacred ritual of abhishek to Shri Ghanshyam Maharaj. Beautiful Indian delicacies were also offered to the deities, as a grand Annakut was prepared in amazement to all those present. In honor of the occasion and to pray for world peace a mahapuja was performed shortly afterward inside the mandir with devotees taking part in the event.

The opening of the gate ceremony, which stands as a magnificent entrance to the mandir and structured in a traditional fashion with delicate statues and statuettes adored with various symbols to welcome all who come to visit God, took place thereafter. Bartlett Village President Catherine Melchert, DuPage County politicians and state legislators, Sen. John Milner and DuPage County Board Chairman Robert Schillerstrom took part in the ceremony. Afterwards the honorable guests addressed the audience with both word exclaiming the beauty of the mandir and the importance of BAPS to society.

The evening assembly witnessed the celebration of the 1st Patotsav and the festival of Janmashtmi. A grand assembly hall set the scene for the evening festival. Decorated with splendid lighting, a stage displaying frames of events allowing the devotees to reminisce on the 16-day festival was constructed. Cultural programs consisting of dramas, dances, speeches, and audiovisual presentation re-developed the memories, of all those present, centering on Mandir Mahotsav. The dedicated volunteers who have served the mission of Swamishri were recognized to warm and friendly applause of all those present. P.E.A.C.E., the underlying theme of the Mandir Mahotsav which stands for Purity in life, Education of the heart, Attachment to the Lord and Guru, Care for one's family and self, and the eradication of Expectations. These components were also the centerpiece of the evening program with stage programs going along with each component.

The indescribable joy and historic events, which took place during Mandir Mahotsav, were revealed to all via a special DVD set consisting of three illustrious DVD's highlighting the events during Mandir Mahotsav.

As the evening progressed, Kishores and Yuvaks held a kirtan aradhna, celebrating Janmashtmi, which lasted until midnight. The devotion-filled devotees headed to the mandir and performed the auspicious aarti celebrating the birthday of Shri Krishna Bhagwan.
The same enthusiasm and eagerness was relevant on this day as it was exactly one year ago when Swamishri performed the inauguration ceremony of the Chicago Mandir in Bartlett, IL.

After Swamishri completed his morning puja, he performed the foundation-stone laying rituals of a research centre for the renowned Shankar Netralayam (Eye Hospital). Swamishri also blessed Shri Badrinathji and his colleagues.
Today during the meetings, the chief reporter of "Gujarat Samachar", published from Vadodara, came. He asked Mahant Swami Maharaj, "What is your message for Vadodara?"
"Worship God," Swamishri said.

ds.t: Accepted as guru in his mind
w: Today during the midday meal, a chapter of special experiences related to Mahant Swami Maharaj opened up. In it the sadhus said:

"A seeker here very much wished for Swamibapa's darshan, but Swamibapa passed away to Akshardham. So he was left with regret. When he met the sadhus, they told him about you: 'Now Mahant Swami Maharaj is Pramukh Swami Maharaj's successor; come for his darshan.'
"He came. He had your darshan. Then when the sadhus went to meet him, he was full of joy. He said, 'My regret has gone. Swamishri touched me and I felt complete peace.'"

Another sadhu also told of a well wishing friend of his: "On 15 August 2016, when Narendrabhai Modi came for Swamibapa's darshan, my friend had your darshan beside Narendrabhai. He was deeply impressed by that darshan alone. He said, 'Though he is the guru, how humble this Swamishri is! What simplicity! So I accepted him as my guru in my mind. A guru must be just like this.'"
What an effect Swamishri's humility has!

After Mahant Swami Maharaj's breakfast darshan, a sadhu said jokingly, "Yesterday, during the meal darshan, the youths sang the thal: 'Jamo jamo ne mara jivan jugate, bhojaniya rasbhariya re...' (Eat, eat, my life, these meals full of flavour). But we saw that there is nothing like flavour in this thal. It is flavourless."
The sadhus said, "Even this is better. Before..."
"It was 70% just mung beans," said Swamishri.
The sadhus said, "And even those without salt!"
Everyone laughed. But they also understood the glory of the guru: "To eat such flavourless food all one's life is the height of freedom from attachment to taste!"
Today, in the assembly for the tula of Thakorji, the guru showered blessings:

"A very great work has been done by us. Shriji Maharaj says, 'Whatever you do, even as small as an atom, I consider as big as Mount Meru.' Meru is 100 times bigger than the Himalayas. Where else would you get such a return? Is there any investment where you get a trillion dollars for one dollar? How much Bhagwan gives back! But the trouble is that in return for 5,000 dollars, you may or may not get 50,000 dollars. But it is deposited in the bank of moksha, in the account of moksha. The banks here are rubbish. This is permanent, eternal; it is never destroyed.

To become brahmarup and reside in Akshardham is its fruit, the fruit of seva. Just as rupees have to be changed into dollars and will not work as they are, so the seva you do has to be changed into the currency of Akshardham. Otherwise there is no moksha. The seva we do here is changed into the currency of Akshardham. And if we do this seva with the feeling of glory, of being the servant of servants, of seeing divinity and so on, it becomes infinitely greater and we get Akshardham right here, in cash. Then there is no more coming and going."

Today Shwetmunidas Swami said, "Swami! You had asked me two or three times, 'Has it rained in Houston? Has it rained in Houston?' I had said, 'The biggest hurricane ever has come there...' But you had given the blessing, 'The devotees will be protected; there will be very little damage.' And truly, all the devotees have suffered the least possible damage, and they have been protected in an amazing way. Here are the incidents:

This hurricane hit the town of Rockport directly; the centre of the hurricane, called the 'eye,' was right there. Its speed was 120 to 130 miles per hour. Thick electricity poles and girders were bent, roads were broken and shops were destroyed. 80% of the town has been wiped out. Our devotee Bharatbhai Patel's motel is right on the seashore. There had been a forecast that such a severe hurricane was coming, so he thought, 'Even boarding it up will make no difference!' And since you had given your blessings, he had faith that all would be well. After the hurricane, there was such heavy damage throughout the town that the other motels were in such a state that it would take two or three months to repair everything. When Bharatbhai went to check, what a surprise! His motel had almost no damage, even though it had not been boarded up! He said, 'It is in such good condition that it can be opened within 2 or 3 days.'

This Bharatbhai also builds and sells houses. He had built two houses in this way. Even the windows and doors had yet to be fitted when the hurricane struck. The news was that trees and so on had fallen on the houses around those houses and they were broken. He thought, 'That is it. Not even one plank of our houses will have survived, and whatever is left will be full of water and debris...'
He got there and saw, to his great amazement, that both these houses were completely safe! And in neither was there even a drop of water or a speck of debris!"
"Laukikanam hi sadhunam artham vag anuvartate,
Rishinam punar adyanam vacham artho'nudhavati."
That is, the words of worldly good people follow the facts, but for great sadhus, the facts follow their words; that is to say, whatever they say comes true.
In the evening, Dr Subramanyam, who had performed Pramukh Swami Maharaj's bypass operation, came to meet Mahant Swami Maharaj.

As soon as he sat down, he said, "Pramukh Swami Maharaj has given you to us, right? Way back from 2012. It's our privilege and honour for you to be the leader, and to lead everybody. It's a blessing from Bapa."
Swamishri said, "It's passed on." Everyone laughed.
Dr Subramanyam then also came to our assembly and spoke very beautifully, saying:
"This will be 19 years ago, that I met Pramukh Swami Maharaj. He did change my life. He did touch my heart, just like he touched all of your hearts.

Then, later on, I came to see current guru, Mahant Swami Maharaj, in Delhi, when I was visiting Akshardham. When I saw him, I thought he was just like Pramukh Maharaj. And he was very simple and looked like a person who respects every individual on the earth.
And also, when he spoke, it was sort of humble in a very kind, low tone and really he never raises his voice.
So now you have a current leader who exemplifies all what Pramukh Swami Maharaj stood for. That is simplicity, humility, selfless-
ness.
He is a perfect leader because, as I said, he will pursue the vision of his late guru without any question. Already he is doing it."
(In Gujarati:) "It was 19 years ago that I met Pramukh Swami Maharaj. He changed my life. He touched my heart, just as he touched the hearts of all of you.

Then I met the present guru, Mahant Swami Maharaj, in Delhi, when I was visiting Akshardham. When I saw him, he was just like Pramukh Swami Maharaj. And he seemed very simple and like a person who respects everyone on this earth. And yes, when he spoke, it was humane, full of kindness and gentle. Truly! He never raises his voice.

So now you have a present guru who is an example of all that was in Pramukh Swami Maharaj: simplicity, humanity and selflessness. He is a perfect leader, because, as I said, there is no question that he will follow the vision (ideals) of his guru Pramukh Swami Maharaj, who now resides in Akshardham. And he is already doing it."
"The same Gunatit legacy...": he too came to this conviction.
